title: Support vector machine predicts cysteine cathepsin cleavage sites from proteomic data
summary: Proteomics of cell lysates with six human cathepsins identified about 30,000 cleavage sites, which were analysed with the SAPS-ESI platform to build clusters and training sets for support vector machine learning. Predictions of cleavage on the SARS-CoV-2 spike protein were confirmed experimentally and suggested furin-like behaviour of cathepsins. Crystal structures of peptides bound to cathepsin V showed rigid and flexible sites consistent with the proteomic patterns. The abstract does not give validation counts.
